answers.core: It is a safeguard against loss of work. Which is priceless IMHO.
answers.workaround: Once one realizes that the blunder happens, it is often too late. Best solution would be NOT to save the scene (it is so easy to hit Ctrl-S and not obvious to perceive the live change), close Godot and edit the .gd file using an external editor. This requires awareness of the destructive calls happening beforehand.

title: Protection against accidental, script-triggered node deletion in tool mode (loss of work danger!)
